Game Description:
My personal indie game, titled 'Astro Combat,' is now available on Steam. I welcome you to add it to your wishlist.
​
In this game, you take on the role of a space explorer with dreams of freedom. On the brink of completing the construction of a Dyson Sphere in a small star system, you are suddenly attacked by a higher unknown civilization. In this lopsided battle, you are no match for them, and even your physical form is destroyed. At the critical moment, your spaceship activates an ultimate rescue system, extracting your DNA and implanting it into an auxiliary robot, beginning a journey of rebirth. Having lost everything, your spaceship is severely damaged and is forced to make an emergency landing on a planet with a primitive civilization.
Alone and with limited resources on this unfamiliar planet, you must start from scratch, search for supplies, and rebuild your life. During this arduous journey, you encounter one of the 12 trapped Astro Spirits who seeks your help to rescue her sisters. You accept this mission, using the opportunity to delve into the secrets of this mysterious planet. You will traverse various regions, experience exotic cultures, make friends, face challenges, and ultimately save all 12 Astro Sprites, absorbing their energy. After repairing your spaceship, you will depart from this planet to continue your adventures in the vast universe.
Game language:
English
Chinese
Due to the limited capacity of a single developer, the game has not yet been fully translated into English. However, an English language version will definitely be added as a priority once the development is complete.
Game Genre:
ARPG + RTT
The game can be played according to your preferences. If you enjoy arcade-style beat-'em-ups, you can engage enemies head-on. For those who prefer tactical gameplay, consider optimizing your approach to hitting enemies; with the right techniques, you can easily defeat foes that are of a higher level. A party can consist of up to four members (including the leader). During battles, as long as the current member has not been defeated or affected by certain negative statuses, you can switch members to respond to different enemy attacks.
Game Flavors:
Sci-Fi
